newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hoiupank in demand on sluggish Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hoiupank in demand on sluggish Estonian bourse.

text.p: Hoiupank took almost half of the trade on the Tallinn bourse on Thursday and dealers were at a loss to explain why.
Overall market volume was 46 million kroons versus Wednesday's 55.8 million kroons and the Talse index lost 0.2 percent to close at 251.98.
Hoiupank was by far the most active share in trade of 20.7 million kroons and it closed 1.32 kroons higher at 133.12 kroons.
One dealer said the stock had long-term potential and that it planned to revise its 1997 profit estimate and expansion plans.
But most dealers said there was no real news to push its price up.
Hansapank fell 1.25 kroons to close at 129.50 kroons in trade of 5.9 million kroons.
One dealer said that some investors might have taken their profits.
Trade in other shares was very slow.
On the free market, Rakvere meat factory was the most active share in trade of 1.75 million kroons and it eased slightly to 15.25 kroons.
